concept_map.chapter_overview: Aaj hum NCERT Class 8 Social Science ke Chapter 4 — ग्रामीण क्षेत्र पर शासन चलाना (Ruling the Countryside) — ko padhenge. Is chapter mein dekhenge ki 1765 mein East India Company Bengal ki Diwani kaise haath mein li, Permanent Settlement, Mahalwari aur Ryotwari se revenue kaise ikattha kiya, aur Europe ki zarooraton ke liye indigo jaise crops farmers se kaise ugwaye. Yeh chapter batata hai ki Company ne rural India ko kaise colonise kiya — income, rights aur forced cultivation ke through.
concept_map.welcome: Good morning, bacchon! Aaj Smart Board par ek bahut important history chapter shuru karte hain — ग्रामीण क्षेत्र पर शासन चलाना. Socho: ek trading company pehle silk-cotton kharidti thi, phir suddenly woh Diwan ban gayi — lagaan vasoolne lagi, zameen ke niyam banaye, aur farmers se indigo ugwaya. Aaj hum samjhenge ki Company ne gaon-dehat par shasan kaise chalaya. Ready ho? Chalo blackboard ki taraf!
learning_outcomes: 1765 ki Diwani aur Company ke naye economic role ko clearly explain karna
Permanent Settlement (1793) ki shartein, zamindar-raiyat relations aur uski samasyaon ko compare karna
Mahalwari aur Ryotwari (Munro) systems ke differences identify karna
Indigo ki European demand, Nij aur Ryoti cultivation methods aur unki problems ko source-based examples se samjhana

concepts.name: कंपनी की आमदनी और बंगाल का संकट
स्थायी बंदोबस्त की समस्याएँ और रैयतों की दशा
यूरोप के लिए फ़सलें और भारतीय नील की माँग
नील की खेती – निज और रैयती व्यवस्था

generated.say: Bacchon, aaj ka pehla bada point — कंपनी दीवान बन गई. 12 August 1765 ko Mughal Badshah ne East India Company ko Bengal ka Diwan taiynaat kiya. Diwani ka matlab kya hai? Matlab ab Company us ilake ke economic cases ki mukhya shasak ban gayi — zameen ka shasan chalana aur aamdani vyavasthit karna uska kaam ho gaya. Picture 1 mein Robert Clive ko Mughal Badshah se Bihar aur Odisha ki Diwani grahan karte dikhaya gaya hai. Asal mein yeh ghatna shayad Clive ke tambu mein, thode se Angrezon aur Hindustaniyon ki maujoodgi mein hui hogi, lekin painter ne ise bhavya samaroh banaya — kyunki Clive ne apne life ke memorable moments paint karwane ka zimma usi painter ko diya tha. Bengal ki Diwani Angrezon ke liye bilkul badi ghatna thi. Ab Company ko do cheezein saath-saath sochni thi: pehle, apne badhte kharchon ke liye kaafi revenue jutana; doosre, trading company hone ke naate apni zaroorat ki cheezein kharidte-bechte rehna. Rural markets — jaise Murshidabad ka weekly haat — mein peasants aur artisans regularly aate the. Economic crisis ke time in bazaaron par bura asar padta tha. Company ko yeh bhi samajh aaya ki bahari taakat hone ke bawajood use un logon ko shaant rakhna hoga jo pehle gaon mein shasan chala chuke the — unhe control karna zaroori tha, lekin khatam nahi kiya ja sakta tha. Is chapter mein hum dekhenge Company ne rural areas ko colonise kaise kiya, income kaise jutayi, logon ke rights kaise tay kiye, aur manmaafi crops ki kheti kaise karwayi.
generated.example: School canteen socho — pehle sirf snacks bechti thi; phir usko school fees bhi collect karne ka adhikar mil gaya. Ab woh trader bhi hai aur revenue collector bhi — bilkul Company Diwan banne jaisa double role.

Diwan = economic administrator: land revenue + organise income
Company needed: high revenue for expenses + continue trade purchases

worked_example.problem: Diwan banne ke baad Company ke saamne do mukhya challenges kya the? Short answer likho.

Challenge 1: badhte kharchon ke liye kaafi aamdani jutana aur zameen ka shasan chalana
Challenge 2: trading company ke taur par zaroorat ki cheezein kharidte-bechte rehna; purane local power-holders ko control karna bina unhe poora khatam kiye
worked_example.answer: Company ko (1) revenue organise karke expenses poora karna tha, aur (2) trade continue rakhte hue local powerful groups ko control (not destroy) karna tha.

generated.concept: कंपनी की आमदनी और बंगाल का संकट
generated.say: Ab dekho — कंपनी की आमदनी. Company Diwan toh ban gayi, lekin abhi bhi khud ko ek vyapari hi maanti thi. Woh heavy-bharakam lagaan chahati thi, lekin assessment aur collection ki regular system banane mein hichkichati thi. Uski koshish yeh thi ki zyada se zyada revenue hasil kare aur kam se kam keemat par badhiya cotton aur silk cloth kharide. Isi wajah se paanch saal ke bheetar Bengal mein Company dwara kharidi jane wali cheezon ka kul mulya diguna ho gaya. 1765 se pehle Company Britain se sone-chandi import karke maal kharidti thi. Ab Bengal mein ikattha hone wale paise se hi export ke liye cheezein kharidi ja sakti thin — matlab Indian wealth se hi Indian goods kharidna. Jaldi yeh zahir ho gaya ki Bengal ki economy deep crisis mein fasati ja rahi hai. Artisans gaon chhodkar bhaag rahe the kyunki unhe bahut kam keemat par apni cheezein Company ko zabardasti bechni padti thin. Peasants apna lagaan nahi chuka pa rahe the. Artisans ka utpadan gir raha tha aur kheti chaupat hone ki disha mein badh rahi thi. 1770 mein pade akaal ne Bengal mein ek crore logon ko maut ki neend sula diya — lagbhag ek-tihai aabadi samaapt ho gayi. Ab sawaal: agar economy crisis mein thi, toh kya Company apni revenue income ke baare mein aashvast reh sakti thi? Company ke zyadatar officers ko lagne laga ki zameen mein investment aur kheti mein sudhaar laana zaroori hai. Yeh debate do dashakon tak chali — aur isi se Permanent Settlement ka raasta bana.
generated.example: Shopkeeper socho jo grahak se force karke sasta maal le, phir usi gaon se heavy tax bhi maange — log bhaagenge, production giregi, bazaar tootega. Bilkul 1765–1770 ke Bengal jaisa.
board_lines: Goal: max revenue + cheapest fine cotton & silk
Before 1765: gold/silver from Britain → buy goods; After: Bengal revenue → buy exports
Crisis: artisans flee, peasants can’t pay rent; 1770 famine ≈ 1 crore dead (~1/3 population)
generated.common_mistake: Students sirf 1770 akaal yaad rakhte hain aur bhool jaate hain ki pehle se artisans ko forced cheap sale aur heavy revenue ne economy ko crisis mein daala tha — famine us deep crisis ka bhayankar nateeja tha.

Forced cheap purchase of craft goods — artisans leave village for city work

Baad mein: Bengal ke collected revenue se hi export goods kharidna

generated.say: Economy crisis mein thi, toh Company ko kheti mein sudhaar chahiye tha. Do dashakon ki bahas ke baad, 1793 mein Company ne स्थायी बंदोबस्त — Permanent Settlement — lagu kiya. Us samay Bengal ka Governor-General Charles Cornwallis tha. Is bandobast ki sharton ke hisaab se rajas aur taluqdars ko zamindars ke roop mein manyata di gayi. Unhe peasants se lagaan vasoolne aur Company ko revenue chukane ka zimma saunpa gaya. Unki taraf se chukai jane wali rashi sthayi roop se tay kar di gayi thi — matlab bhavishya mein kabhi usmein izafa nahi kiya jana tha. Angrezon ko lagta tha isse unhe regular revenue milta rahega aur zamindars ko zameen mein sudhaar ke liye kharch karne ka protsahan milega. Unka logic: kyunki state ki revenue demand badhne wali nahi thi, isliye zamindar badhte utpadan se fayde mein rahenge — jo extra produce hoga, uska faayda unka. Classroom tip: ‘Permanent’ word yaad rakho — amount fixed forever between Company and zamindar. Yeh system Bengal mein lagu hua. Zamindar ab Company aur raiyat ke beech middle layer ban gaye. Company sochti thi investment aayega, agriculture improve hoga, aur uski income safe rahegi. Lekin, jaise hum agle concept mein dekhenge, yeh ummeed poori nahi hui. Board par teen keywords likho: 1793, Cornwallis, fixed revenue forever.
generated.example: Ghar ka kiraya socho jo landlord aur builder ke beech forever fixed ho — builder ko lagta hai ab landlord ghar improve karega kyunki rent nahi badhega. Wahi ummeed Angrezon ne zamindars se ki.
board_lines: 1793: Permanent Settlement (Cornwallis = Governor-General)
Rajas/taluqdars recognised as zamindars → collect rent, pay revenue to Company
Revenue amount fixed forever → hoped: regular income + zamindar invests in land
generated.common_mistake: Students sochte hain Permanent Settlement ne farmers ko zameen ka permanent right de diya — galat. Permanent fixed tha Company ko milne wala revenue; zamindars recognised hue, raiyats ke rights secure nahi the.
generated.memory_trick: P-C-Z: Permanent 1793 — Cornwallis — Zamindars pay fixed revenue Forever.
generated.gesture_action: Teen roles: Company (fixed amount paper pakde), Zamindar (beech mein), Peasant (lagaan de) — ‘amount never increases’ board par circle karo
real_life_examples: Fixed school annual fee forever promise — management ummeed kare parents zyada facilities invest karein
Village lekhpal/patwari chain: collector ← middleman ← cultivator — zamindar middle layer jaisa

worked_example.problem: Permanent Settlement kab lagu hua? Uske do supposed benefits Angrezon ke nazar se likho.
steps: Year: 1793; Cornwallis Governor-General of Bengal
Benefit 1: Company ko regular, fixed revenue milta rahega
Benefit 2: Zamindars ko zameen improve karne ka incentive — kyunki state demand nahi badhegi, extra produce unka faayda
worked_example.answer: 1793. Benefits hoped: (1) secure regular revenue for Company; (2) zamindars invest in land improvement because revenue demand would not rise.

generated.concept: स्थायी बंदोबस्त की समस्याएँ और रैयतों की दशा
generated.say: Magar स्थायी बंदोबस्त ne bhi samasya paida kar di. Zamindar abhi bhi zameen improve nahi kar rahe the. Company ka fixed revenue itna zyada tha ki chukana mushkil tha. Jo fail hota, uski zamindari cheen li jati — bahut si auction ho gayin. Unnisvin sadi ke pehle dashak tak keematein badhin, kheti faili, zamindar aamdani sudhri — lekin Company ko faayda nahi, kyunki revenue forever fix tha; ab badha nahi sakti thi. Jo zamindar bache, unhe bina investment ke bhi aamdani dikhai di — jab tak peasants se lagaan milta raha, improvement ki parvah nahi. Gaon mein farmers ko yeh vyavastha damankari lagi: lagaan bahut zyada, zameen ka adhikar asurakshit. Lagaan ke liye mahajan se karza; nahi chuka paye toh pushtaini zameen se bedakhal. Source 1 — H.T. Colebrooke (1860): kai powerful raiyats khud kheti nahi karte, doosron ko patte dekar bhari lagaan vasoolte. Batai aur begari se dabe kashtkar karz se bahar nahi nikalte; jeene ko poora nahi, toh dil laga kar kaam kaise? Unnisvin sadi ki shuruaat mein hi kai officers maan chuke the ki bandobast mein badlav zaroori hai — expenses badhte rahe, permanent fix se aur paise kaise aayenge?

worked_example.problem: Permanent Settlement Company aur raiyats dono ke liye kaise problem bani? Do-do points.
steps: Company early: revenue itna high ki zamindaris auction; later: cannot raise revenue when prices rose
Raiyats: excessive rent, insecure tenure, mahajan debt, eviction from ancestral land
Zamindars often preferred rent collection over investment; under-tenants crushed (Colebrooke)
worked_example.answer: Company: (1) early defaults/auctions (2) later could not increase fixed revenue. Raiyats: (1) high insecure rent (2) debt and eviction; under-tenants oppressed under batai/begar.

generated.say: Unnisvin sadi ki shuruaat mein Company officers ko yakeen ho chuka tha ki revenue bandobast mein badlav chahiye. Sawal simple tha: jab Company ko shasan aur trade ke kharche ke liye aur paise chahiye, toh sthayi roop se revenue fix karke kaam kaise chalega? Bengal Presidency ke north-western provinces ke liye — jiska zyadatar hissa aaj Uttar Pradesh mein hai — Holt Mackenzie naam ke Angrez ne ek nayi vyavastha taiyar ki, jo 1822 mein lagu hui. Mackenzie ko vishwas tha ki north Indian society mein gaon ek mahatvapurna samajik sanstha hai aur usko bachaye rakhna chahiye. Uske aadesh par collectors ne gaon-gaon ka daura kiya, zameen ki jaanch ki, kheton ko mapa, aur vibhinn groups ke riti-riwajon ko darj kiya. Gaon ke ek-ek khet ke estimated revenue ko jodkar har gaon ya gram-samuh — jise महाल kehte hain — se vasool hone wale revenue ka hisaab lagaya jata tha. Yeh revenue sthayi roop se tay nahi kiya gaya; usmein samay-samay par sanshodhanon ki gunjaish rakhi gayi. Revenue ikattha karke Company ko ada karne ka zimma zamindar ki bajay gaon ke mukhiya ko saunp diya gaya. Is vyavastha ko महालवारी बंदोबस्त naam diya gaya. Board tip: Mahal = British revenue documents mein ek revenue unit — ek gaon ya gaonon ka samuh. Contrast yaad rakho: Permanent = fixed forever with zamindar; Mahalwari = revisable, village/mahal based, headman responsible.

worked_example.problem: Mahalwari aur Permanent Settlement mein do clear antar likho.
steps: Who pays/collects: Permanent → zamindar; Mahalwari → village headman
Is revenue fixed?: Permanent → forever fixed; Mahalwari → periodic revision possible
Unit: Permanent → zamindari estates; Mahalwari → village or group of villages (mahal) after detailed survey
worked_example.answer: (1) Zamindar vs village headman as revenue payer/collector. (2) Permanently fixed vs revisable revenue estimated from field surveys of the mahal.

generated.say: British control wale south Indian ilakon mein bhi Permanent Settlement ki jagah nayi vyavastha aayi — रैयतवाड़ ya रैयतवारी. Captain Alexander Read ne Tipu Sultan ke saath chale yuddh ke baad Company ke kabze wale kuch ilakon mein isse aazma kar dekha tha. Thomas Munro ne is vyavastha ko vikasit kiya aur dheere-dheere poore southern India par yahi lagu kar di gayi. Picture 4 mein Madras ke Governor Thomas Munro (1819–1826) dikhte hain. Read aur Munro ko lagta tha ki south mein paramparagat zamindar nahi the. Isliye unka tark: seedhe farmers — raiyats — se hi bandobast karo jo peedhiyon se zameen par kheti karte aa rahe hain. Revenue assessment se pehle unke kheton ka savdhani se alag-alag survey hona chahiye. Munro ka manna tha ki Angrezon ko pita ki bhaanti farmers ki raksha karni chahiye — paternal approach. Lekin सब कुछ ठीक नहीं था. Nayi vyavasthaayein lagu hone ke kuch hi saal baad problems dikhne lagin. Zameen se aamdani badhane ke chakkar mein revenue officers ne bahut zyada revenue tay kar diya. Peasants chuka nahi pa rahe the. Raiyat gaonon se bhaag rahe the; bahut se kshetron mein gaon veeran ho gaye. Optimistic officers ummeed karte the ki nayi system peasants ko sampann udyamheel kisan bana degi — lekin aisa hua nahi. Yaad rakho chain: Read tried → Munro developed → direct settlement with raiyat → high demand → flight and deserted villages.

worked_example.problem: Ryotwari system kahan lagu hui? Munro ka ‘pita ki bhaanti’ idea kya tha, aur asaliyat mein kya hua?
steps: Region: southern India (after experiments by Read in areas taken after Tipu wars)
